about_desc1: I created this application because getting started with stargazing can be overwhelming. There are too many apps with too much data.
about_desc2: I built this to focus on exactly what matters most for a beginner: knowing what's in the sky tonight, where to point the telescope, and nothing else.
about_collab_title: Want to collaborate or request a feature?
target_disclaimer: 🔭 Visibility depends on local sky conditions, light pollution, and your equipment. This database highlights the most prominent targets for amateur stargazers and beginners.
footer_desc: Personal stargazing dashboard to track active constellations, planets, and ISS passes.
tour_loc_desc: Start by setting your exact coordinates so we can calculate the night sky accurately for you.
tour_cond_desc: Before heading out, check the weather and seeing conditions. We'll tell you if tonight is a GO.
tour_targets_desc: Use this curated database to find the best and brightest objects to point your telescope at tonight.
tour_night_desc: Once you're outside in the dark, turn on Night Vision mode to protect your eyes' dark adaptation.
night_vision_desc: Reduces glare to protect your dark adaptation.
footer_like: Like this dashboard? Give it a star!
asteroid_info: Near-Earth Objects (NEOs) passing by Earth tonight. Data from NASA NeoWs API.
simbad_instruction: ✨ Click on any star to scan it via SIMBAD
simbad_error: Could not resolve star data at this location.
info_ai: Target recommendations curated by Qwen3.5-9B AI
neo_tip: Near-Earth Objects passing within 7.5M km tonight. Data from NASA NeoWs API.
comet_tip: Notable comets currently in the inner solar system. Some are visible with binoculars or a small telescope.
meteor_tip: Upcoming major meteor showers, ranked by peak date. ZHR = Zenithal Hourly Rate under ideal dark skies.
scheduler_empty_hint: Click "Add to Plan" on any target card in the database above to plan your night session.
no_planet_data: Could not load planet data — API may be offline
no_planets_visible: No major planets visible above the horizon right now
no_targets_found: No prominent deep-sky targets cataloged for this constellation yet, or none match your current filters. Try selecting a different constellation above!
no_targets_visible_now: No targets visible right now. Conditions might be poor, or it's daytime!
